name: doom-modern
description: A faithful browser recreation of DOOM (1993) with modern FPS mechanics, physics and gore.

scripts.ct:assets: python3 tools/ct/textures.py && python3 tools/ct/audio.py && python3 tools/ct/render_zombies.py && python3 tools/ct/render_props.py
scripts.ct:map: node tools/ct/unpack.mjs --if-missing && node tools/ct/build-map.mjs --no-preview && node tools/ct/pack.mjs && node tools/ct/lib/validate.mjs assets/wads/chinatown.wad CHINATWN && node tools/ct/check-map.mjs assets/wads/chinatown.wad
scripts.ct:test: node tools/ct/test-engine.mjs && node tools/ct/test-ct.mjs && node tools/ct/test-ct.mjs assets/wads/chinatown.wad
